slug: 2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards

facts.fact: The government has presented the national strategy Tchad Connexion 2030, with US$1.5bn of planned digital investment and a six-year horizon to 2031 at most, to extend digital coverage to most of the population; the document gives no presentation date, so its published date, 2025-12-10, is used.
